mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as lower borrowing costs boost corporate valuation multiples without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 1.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days due to reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns, with Rank IC < 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), rising interest rates suppress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as corporate borrowing costs increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production increase above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1100 thousand units signal weak consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as economic activity decelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST falls below 1100 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as hiring freezes reduce future earnings potential.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative returns, with Rank IC < 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a retail sales decline below 480,000 million dollars signals consumer demand exhaustion, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as valuations adjust to slowing growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS falls below 480000 during late-cycle expansions.
